The question asks which PRs added or removed a line containing `encounterProviders` under `packages/esm-service-queues-app`, and when each merged. Four merged PRs match. I searched the default branch (HEAD), since the pinned head wasn't specified, and used each commit's date as its merge date. I did not check the PR metadata for merge timestamps.

1. **#2824, merged 2026-10-14** (O3-6098, commit `a7bd671`). It changes the `custom:(...encounterProviders:...)` representation string in `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/constants.ts:24`, removing and re-adding it.
2. **#2600, merged 2026-08-28** (O3-5763, commit `7212897`). It removes `encounterProviders` lines from `current-visit/current-visit.resource.ts:15`, `current-visit/hooks/useVitalsConceptMetadata.ts:63-64` and `current-visit/visit-details/current-visit-details.component.tsx:46`, and also changes the `constants.ts:24` string.
3. **#2583, merged 2026-07-29** (O3-5693, commit `171573d`). It removes a line containing `encounterProviders` from `packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/hooks/useQueueEntries.ts:9`.
4. **#2541, merged 2026-06-08** (O3-5679, commit `49a93f0`). It adds and removes `encounterProviders` lines in `packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/past-visit/past-visit-details/past-visit-summary.component.tsx:67-68, 80-81, 97`.

Excluded: commit `d3b8ab5` (#2623, 2026-07-16) also matched, but only under `e2e/commands/encounter-operations.ts`, which is outside `esm-service-queues-app`.
